basics.name: Doruk Doğan
basics.title: Performance Marketing & Technical Web Operations Specialist
basics.summary: Performance marketing and technical web operations specialist scaling commercial growth for international brands across 16+ European markets and building custom automation systems.

pillars.title: Performance Marketing & Paid Social
pillars.subtitle: ROAS-driven ad operations across EU markets
pillars.description: Designed and executed high-impact performance media plans on TikTok, Meta, Pinterest, and Snapchat. Managed dynamic product feeds and automated creator content ingestion pipelines via Smartly.io and Klear.

pillars.title: Technical SEO & Search Strategy
pillars.subtitle: Data-led site health, architecture & keyword clusters
pillars.description: Led in-depth technical SEO audits, crawl budget remediation, and semantic keyword cluster analyses for international enterprise accounts including Eurowings, TP Vision, and Wolters Kluwer.

pillars.title: Omnichannel Web Operations & Experimentation
pillars.subtitle: Enterprise CMS localization & experimentation
pillars.description: Managed multi-market page rollouts in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), executed conversion rate A/B experimentation programs via Adobe Target, and led enterprise intranet UX/UI architecture in Figma and AEM.

experience.summary: Managed multi-market paid media campaigns across 16+ European markets and automated creator tracking workflows.
highlights: Designed and executed multi-market paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest, driving a 27% YoY increase in conversion volume while reducing average CPC by 27% through Smartly.io.
Synthesized cross-channel campaign evaluations across European markets, improving average ROAS from 84% to 121% on Meta and reducing CPA by up to 43% on TikTok.
Architected an API-driven creator ingestion workflow in Klear, automating Story tracking across TikTok and Instagram and resolving seasonal platform rate limits.

experience.summary: Delivered enterprise web localization and conversion rate experimentation.
highlights: Implemented and localized enterprise web experiences in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) for global product launches, maintaining design system consistency and localization quality across regional markets.
Translated business hypotheses into measurable A/B testing programmes in Adobe Target, using Adobe Analytics and Google Analytics to evaluate experiment outcomes and drive conversion improvements.

experience.summary: Conducted technical SEO audits, search strategies, and enterprise intranet UX/UI architecture.
highlights: Conducted comprehensive enterprise technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, JavaScript rendering, and site architecture across international accounts (Eurowings, TP Vision, Wolters Kluwer).
Developed search and content strategies through search-intent modelling, topic clustering, and content-gap research to capture high-intent commercial traffic.
Led the UX/UI architecture and template redesign for NMQ Digital's enterprise intranet using Figma and AEM, establishing standardized page taxonomy and knowledge discovery.

experience.summary: Designed and launched B2B digital advisory platform on Framer with regional search architecture.
highlights: Participated in the design and launch of a B2B digital advisory platform on Framer for a hospitality consulting firm.
Engineered regional technical SEO architecture and commercial search-intent taxonomy across the Carolinas.
Implemented an automated dual-route lead capture workflow and optimized frontend asset delivery.

experience.summary: Developed interactive digital portfolio showcase with real-time multi-attribute filtering.
highlights: Developed an interactive digital portfolio showcase platform for an architectural studio with real-time multi-attribute filtering.
Optimized technical page speed and search metadata schema across 21 responsive project showcase pages, achieving sub-second load times.
